# IBM Plex Sans

Unmodified Regular, Medium and SemiBold TTF files from
[IBM/plex](https://github.com/IBM/plex/tree/bf260093582f04622aacc1e9f9ca604d7ccd0c42/packages/plex-sans/fonts/complete/ttf),
revision `bf260093582f04622aacc1e9f9ca604d7ccd0c42`.

Copyright 2017 IBM Corp. Licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 in
[LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt). The shell embeds these fonts as Windows resources,
so Modern works without installing fonts or relying on the working directory.
Segoe UI is read from the Windows Fonts directory and is not redistributed.
